title: A clearer setup screen and dashboard
changes: /setup and the dashboard now list every feature, including Blacklist, Sticky Messages, Reaction Roles and Civilian Jobs - these existed but were missing from setup, so most servers never knew they were available
Both now separate features that are ready from features that are switched on but unfinished, and tell you exactly what each one is still missing
The dashboard's feature counter shows how many features are actually working instead of how many switches are flipped
/help now lists all 77 commands and every feature - it had been hand-written and was missing business accounts, loans, civilian jobs, sticky messages and reaction roles entirely
Premium badges now appear consistently across the site, dashboard and bot instead of only after you were refused
/setup no longer refuses to help until you add yourself as a staff member - administrators already had access
